newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end up on buy-backs, rise in Euroyen futures.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end up on buy-backs, rise in Euroyen futures.

text.p: *Key December JGB futures ended slightly higher in Tokyo due to buy-backs and a rise in Euroyen futures, traders said. *Traders said September machinery orders figures were weaker than expected, while outlook for October-December period was stronger than expected.
